title: Deterministic authorization of every agent tool call
objective: Every agent tool call is authorized by server-side code against the principal's recorded authority and the authority matrix; the model's output is never the authorization decision.
implementing_systems: Unbound API and authority matrix (designed, not built)

title: Untrusted content passed only as quoted data
objective: Documents, messages, retrieved web content and tool results are parsed at trust boundaries into typed data and supplied to models as quoted data, never merged into instructions or tool definitions.

residual_risks: Models can still follow instructions embedded in quoted data; this control reduces, not eliminates, injection.
